plugins.name: picui-image-host
plugins.description: Connect ZCode to the picui.cn image-hosting API: view profile/storage usage, list and upload images, manage albums, delete with explicit confirmation.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 让 ZCode 通过 MCP 直连 picui.cn 图床：查看账号容量、列出/上传图片、删除图片与相册（删除需显式确认）。需先配置图床 Token。
